rows.public_rationale: Liveness probe on the operator listener; returns no tenant data and is reached only by the orchestrator.
Readiness probe on the operator listener; reports dependency state only and is reached only by the orchestrator.

gaps: The in-cluster internal identity headers are a third carrier accepted only on the internal listener (internal/queryapi/internalidentity); the closed credential vocabulary has no class for them, so they are named here, not classified.
Per-resolver authorization (CHAOS-4732: no auth chokepoint) is not profiled; this row states what the surface accepts, not what each resolver enforces.

primary_validator.description: authenticateInternalRequest picks the carrier and refuses ambiguity; the envelope is verified by principal.Verifier.Verify.

token_shape.token_type: EdDSA JWT (envelope) or HS256 JWT (edge access token)
